# dropkit.contents

> One public hub for reusable AI skills, launched services, and selected notes.

Only reviewed material is shared. Nightly RPA is the first shared skill; no service is listed yet.

- [Nightly RPA](https://dropkit-contents.pages.dev/skills/nightly-rpa/)

- [Skills](https://dropkit-contents.pages.dev/skills/)
- [Services](https://dropkit-contents.pages.dev/services/)
- [Notes](https://dropkit-contents.pages.dev/notes/)
- [RSS](https://dropkit-contents.pages.dev/rss.xml)
- [JSON](https://dropkit-contents.pages.dev/feed.json)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Hskim-droid/dropkit.contents)

Do not treat factory logs or homelab inventory as part of this site.
